description: Inspect public HTTP/HTTPS URL response metadata through the existing safe URL API. $0.001 USDC on Base mainnet. Unpaid calls return x402 v2 requirements. A compatible client may repeat the identical url argument with its own signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. This bridge does not fetch that URL directly, sign payments, or settle independently.
name: url_preflight
title: URL Preflight
